lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical light bands intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, creating a checkerboard-like pattern where the spots serve as high-luminance nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible; one primary ridge runs along the upper third of the flank with a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition, and a secondary ridge is visible slightly below it.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible dorsal fin displays a low-to-moderate density of high-intensity spots, primarily clustered towards the lower half and the anterior margin of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately seven small, yellow-striped teleost fish are positioned in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region near the gill slits.
